    G

    Game - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.model
    Represents a game session and manages its global state, including participating Players, the Board, the current turn, remote observers (RMI/TCP), and Event results.
    Game(List, int, Board, List, Player, String, int, List) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.model.Game
    Creates a game starting from an already existing state, filled with the specified data.
    This constructor is used for loading and restoring a previously saved game.
    Game(List, Random) - Constructor for class it.polimi.ingsw.model.Game
    Creates a new game by initializing the Board, the initial game state, and all structures required for observer and turn management.
    GameController - Class in it.polimi.ingsw.controller
    Controller responsible for managing all active games on the server.
